messages:
Priya (AE): Heads-up: NordBank asked for a short POC to exit VendorX and onboard Redwood. Key asks: minimal adapter, parity checks for prompts/functions, cost delta, and security questionnaire. Can SE + Eng triage?

Luca (Sales Eng): I'll lead SE. Scope suggestion: 1) tiny shim proxy to accept VendorX shape, 2) run 200 golden prompts through both systems, 3) cost delta report, 4) security checklist completed, 5) 48h canary in eu-west.

Sam (Platform Eng): Adapter note: VendorX posts {conversation:[{role,text}], session_id}. Redwood expects {messages:[{role,content}], model:"rwd-1"}. We can ship a ~100-line proxy to map fields + normalize function-calls.

Luca (Sales Eng): Example pseudo-mapping:
```
let messages = body.conversation.map(m=>({role:m.role,content:m.text}));
post('/redwood', {model:'rwd-1', messages});
```

Ali (Client-IT): We will provide a 72h traffic dump and 200 golden prompts. Need EU-only residency, Okta SSO, and egress IP allowlist.

Tess (Security): Send them our questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/security/questionnaire-v2. Primary asks: SOC2, KMS CMK support, pen-test summary, log retention policy, ability to redact PII before logs.

Sam (Platform Eng): Parity buckets: 1) templated exact-match, 2) semantic similarity (cosine >= 0.85), 3) function-calling contract tests. We'll run A/B harness and produce a delta % for each bucket.

Priya (AE): Commercials: propose 6-month Dedicated reserved pricing + a migration credit (cover up to 40 eng hours). Will that be OK?

Luca (Sales Eng): Yes, migration credit ok. Also ask client to define acceptance thresholds (e.g., semantic >=0.85 or <5% critical failures).

ci-bot: staging env created: staging-nord-eu (eu-west-1)

Sam (Platform Eng): For billing delta we'll token-count their dump and run against Redwood hosted and reserved rates. Expect to produce an estimate within 48h after we get logs.

Ali (Client-IT): Sounds good. We'll send dump + legal will fill questionnaire today.

Priya (AE): Thanks everyone. Luca/Sam, confirm 0.5 FTE for first week and 0.25 for canary? If yes, I'll schedule kickoff next Monday.

Sam (Platform Eng): Confirmed 0.5 FTE week1, on-call during canary.

Luca (Sales Eng): I'll draft handoff and include migration credit terms.

Priya (AE): Great, locking calendar. Thanks :thumbsup:
